rationale: The agent authenticated the user, but then executed multiple order-changing actions (exchange, return, modify) without first obtaining explicit user confirmation. It also performed a return on the luggage item when the user requested an exchange, which does not match the request. These issues violate the policy requirements to confirm before writes and to perform the requested changes accurately and completely.
